title: Cain and Abel
reflectionText: Before the blow ever fell, Yahweh warned him: sin is crouching at your door, but you must rule over it. And after the blow, even the one who would not listen was given a mark to keep him alive. What does it mean that mercy meets us both before the sin we are about to commit, and after the one we can never undo?
editorialNotes: Wave 1d (Full-Canon Production Gate CG02). Genesis 4:1-16, absent both lanes (verified). Primeval-arc beat 3. Adult-only (the murder is irreducible; no kid lane).
